[imageid=9564394 medium rep]▪️ Greenwood is now available from Capstone Games. from designers Christos Giannakoulas and Manolis Zachariadis, this is the next big box Euro game! This game plays 1-4 players in 40-160 minutes!
From the Capstone Website:

In Greenwood, you play as Primal Spirits and lead your companions to save Greenwood.
On each turn, you face the difficult decision of whether to use the abilities of your own companions, to use the abilities of other players’ companions, or to send one of your companions into the forest to improve your wayfinding and rescue mystical creatures.
In the advanced game, each clan has a unique ability – a small additional rule that has a major impact on the game. What makes this special is that players can use the unique ability of any clan currently in play, not just their own.
The game is played over the course of 3 nights, and whoever scored the most victory points wins.

▪️ Chimerium is a new release coming in Q1 from Synapses Games. From the Designers of Encyclopedia & Museum, Eric Dubus and Olivier Melison. A new dice-drafting and area-control game. For 1-4 players and plays in 45-60 minutes
From BGG:

Chimerium is a dice management and area majority game that offers intense strategic depth in both competitive and solo modes.
During the game, players utilize their dice to Study creatures, Acquire Artifacts, or target specific locations in the Nexus to release their Chimeras.
Every choice influences your standing in the majorities—adapt your strategy, watch your opponents, and win the Guild’s favor.

▪️ Cosmo is a new release from Helvetiq. Fromthe designer of Trio, 宮野 華也 (Kaya Miyano). This is a new hand-management game to create the best poker hand! For 2-5 players and plays in 15-20 minutes.
From BGG:

Build your best poker hand by strategically recruiting the perfect crew for your Mission to Mars. Simply draw Cards from any of the six decks! The twist: Some of the players' cards are visible, others are hidden. Can you really be sure the others will end up with a better crew than you?! Once everyone has five cards, it’s time to shine. The strongest hand … uh, crew wins the ticket to Mars.
- Draw cards from any of the six decks and aim for the strongest poker hand.
- Bet on the best hand before drawing your last cards.
- Once everyone has five cards, it’s time to shine. The strongest hand wins.

▪️ Harmonies: Crescendo from Libellud is a new expansions for Harmonies that was just released. If you are looking to expand your game of Harmonies, you can expect 3 new modules to mix in. From designers Johan Benvenuto and Mathieu Rivero. An easy gift for the holidays to that gamer in your life who already loves the base game.
From BGG:

The Crescendo expansion for Harmonies includes 3 new modules that can be used individually or in combination with other modules.
Sanctuaries: Build unique landscapes that can accommodate multiple animals.
New personal game boards offer new field layouts and ways to score points.
Whisper Creatures: Add new cards to your animal cards and create synergies between animals and Whisper Creatures.
